messages:
Hannah Ortiz: Dropping a fresh idea for the latency/heatmap card. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/latency-contextual

High-level:
- Show p95 as a small left metric and keep a wide heatmap.
- Add a contextual sampling control: a tiny kebab next to the timepicker reveals presets (Off / 10% / 25% / 50% / 100%) + Custom slider.
- Introduce a confidence meter next to the chart title: green/yellow/red dot + label (High / Medium / Low) computed from sample percent and window size.
- Allow users to pin an annotation to a vertical slice; pinned annotations show a thin line + summary. If p95 is from sampled data, annotation shows "estimated" flag.
- Keyboard flows: Tab -> presets -> kebab -> sampling -> calendar. Proposal: press "+" to add an annotation when focused on heatmap (needs product review).

Feedback wanted on: confidence meter wording, kebab vs inline control, and annotation discoverability.

Samir Desai: Really like the confidence meter idea 4 makes noise visible. A few quick notes:
- Confidence states: High (>=25% OR window > 1min), Medium (5-25%), Low (<5% OR window <15s). Show exact percent on hover and in DOM.
- Kebab is fine to keep compact; ensure its discoverable on keyboard (aria-label). Custom should open an inline popover, not a full modal.
- Pinning: allow adding title + optional link to ticket. Store author/timestamp. On hover show author; on focus reveal full text.

Becca Long: Accessibility + copy:
- Confidence meter: avoid color-only indicators. Add text label (e.g., "Low confidence") that is always in DOM, possibly visually hidden for compactness but readable by screen readers.
- Kebab menu: implement as button with aria-haspopup=listbox and ensure each item has role=option and aria-selected when open.
- Annotation add shortcut: use "A" and document it in the help overlay; watch for conflicts.
- Tooltip copy proposal for sampled p95: "Estimated from sampled requests; values are approximate."

Ivy Chen: Product/telemetry:
- Telemetry: sampling_percent, sampling_mode (preset/custom), sample_window_ms, annotation_id on query payloads.
- Confidence computation must be reproducible in logs so we can explain alerts; include confidence_level in response metadata.
- For annotation storage we'll keep: id, author, ts, text, linked_ticket (optional), pinned(boolean), and heatmap_x position.

ops-bot: Checklist added to INFR-5233:
- [ ] Kebab sampling menu accessible pattern + visible DOM sample percent
- [ ] Confidence meter shows text AND color and exposes confidence_level in metadata
- [ ] Custom popover slider exposes aria-valuetext and numeric input
- [ ] Annotation pin is keyboard focusable and has aria-label with author+time
- [ ] Telemetry: sampling_percent, sampling_mode, sample_window_ms, confidence_level, annotation_id
- [ ] Shortcut 'A' for add-annotation documented and telemetry for usage

Hannah Ortiz: Thanks all. I'll update the Figma with the confidence meter variants (dot+label vs dot-only+sr-text) and a small prototype of the kebab popover. Scheduling a 20m playtest Tue 10am PT to validate keyboard flow and check the annotation UX. Invite: @Becca Long @Samir Desai @Ivy Chen.

Samir Desai: I'll attend and test the small-window low-confidence case.

Becca Long: I'll run an a11y pass and bring the screen reader script.

Ivy Chen: I'll coordinate with infra to ensure the new metadata fields are emitted in staging.

Hannah Ortiz: Great 389 will post playtest notes and update ticket INFR-5233 after the session."
